title: Takano Josen met Hermann Oberth and discussed UFOs

tellings.quote: And I was just in Japan actually, and there's a guy named Takano Josen, and he met Hermann Oberth and they discussed UFOs openly.
But Dr. Oberth truly respected the beings actually riding in UFOs.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Takano; adds that Oberth respected the beings riding in UFOs.
tellings.link_reason: Takano Josen's own account of what Oberth expressed in the discussion that telling 6 describes.

as_told.title: Oberth respected the beings riding in UFOs

plain: A Japanese man named Takano Josen says he once met the German rocket pioneer Hermann Oberth and that the two spoke openly about UFOs, and that "Dr. Oberth truly respected the beings actually riding in UFOs." Michels says he met Takano on a trip to Japan, and Takano tells the story himself on the same episode, which would mean that a founder of rocketry took UFO occupants seriously.
